cards.title: Drone attacks on Black Sea ships widen the maritime risk picture
cards.summary: Bulgaria says drones struck two merchant ships off its coast, sinking one; Sofia is seeking EU and NATO help while responsibility remains unconfirmed.
detail: Bulgaria says drones struck two merchant ships in its Black Sea exclusive economic zone on Tuesday, sinking one and triggering rescue operations. AP reported that 15 crew members from Chelsea 3 were evacuated, with five treated for minor injuries; one crew member from the sunken vessel was rescued.

The incident brings civilian-shipping risk closer to a NATO member and affects a trade route already exposed to war-related disruption. Bulgaria’s government has formally asked the EU and NATO for technical assistance.

Prime Minister Rumen Radev said the attacks were unacceptable and suggested Russia benefited, but AP also reported that authorities lacked clear evidence identifying the drones. Ukraine denied operating near the sites and Russia had not immediately commented.
The next signals are the full casualty account, attribution evidence, and the allied response. The attacks are established; responsibility and the wider pattern remain unresolved.

cards.title: U.S. freezes Microsoft and other firms out of PERM green-card programme
cards.summary: The administration suspended Microsoft, Adobe and major IT outsourcers from a labor-certification route for employment-based green cards, citing alleged fraud and worker-protection concerns.
detail: The Associated Press and Reuters reported that the administration suspended Microsoft, Adobe, and several major IT outsourcing firms from the Department of Labor’s Permanent Labor Certification Program, known as PERM. The policy matters for technology employers, foreign workers, and universities that depend on international talent. It also creates a test of whether the administration’s enforcement theory survives company responses, agency process, and possible litigation.

The key uncertainty is scope: the public statements describe a suspension and investigations, but the duration, affected filings, and legal challenge path require formal agency notices and company responses.
